claims.text: Course definitions (glossary): continuous delivery keeps every green change deployable by automated steps, a person decides on production; continuous deployment deploys each to production automatically. GitHub Docs' CD page uses 'continuous deployment' for any automated deploy.

claims.text: A job declares a deployment environment with jobs.<job_id>.environment (a name, optionally with url); referencing an environment that does not exist creates an environment with that name.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Workflow syntax > jobs.<job_id>.environment; Managing environments for deployment

claims.text: Protection rules (required reviewers, wait timer, deployment branches and tags, custom) are set on the environment; a job referencing it does not start until they pass. On Free/Pro/Team plans, required reviewers exist only for public repositories (don-hang is public).
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Managing environments for deployment > Deployment protection rules

claims.text: With required reviewers, a job referencing the environment waits for approval (after its needs: jobs have completed) and runs only once a reviewer approves.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Managing environments for deployment > Required reviewers; Reviewing deployments

claims.text: Secrets stored in an environment are available only to workflow jobs that reference the environment; if the environment requires approval, a job cannot access environment secrets until a required reviewer approves it.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Managing environments for deployment > Environment secrets

claims.text: ci.yml@stage-2 lines 85-93: staging job with if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master', needs: [test, image], runs-on: ubuntu-24.04, environment: staging. publish (135-139) has the same if and needs but no environment:.

github.event_name is the name of the event that triggered the run (push, pull_request…) and github.ref for a push is refs/heads/<branch>; so the if: is true only for pushes to master, and pull request runs and other branches skip the job.
